Principal's Welcome 
			Message - Dr. Arjun Chandra Debnath
Dear Students,
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to Ramkrishna Nagar 
			College. Having joined this esteemed institution in 2025, I am 
			delighted to invite you into our academic family. I hope your 
			association with our college marks the beginning of a future filled 
			with success, growth, and countless opportunities.
Ramkrishna Nagar College is a premier institution of higher 
			education and one of the leading colleges in the Barak Valley of 
			Assam. With a glorious history spanning 62 years, the college has 
			earned a distinguished reputation for nurturing talented students 
			who have excelled in diverse fields. At Ramkrishna Nagar College, we 
			value creativity, talent, and innovation. We strive to provide our 
			students with excellent facilities, a harmonious learning 
			environment, and an inclusive campus culture.

Ramkrishna Nagar, situated in a remote 
				corner in the district of Sribhumi, Assam falls under the 
				jurisdiction of Ratabari LA-I (Reserved) and MP-I Sribhumi 
				(Reserved) constituency. The demography of the land comprises 
				SC-ST-OBC-MOBC, EX-TGL and minority community. The natural 
				beauty of the land is emphasized by the surrounding hilly tracks 
				with the lush green tea gardens on the outskirts which add to 
				its grandeur and beauty.
Ramkrishna Nagar College came into being on 
				12th January 1964. The untiring and zealous efforts of a 
				Steering committee, lead by Late B. N. Mukherjee, former 
				Minister of Health, Govt. of Assam, supplemented by the sincere 
				help and co-operation from dedicated educationists, elites and 
				patrons of the locality, brought this seat of learning into 
				existence. It was brought under Deficit Grant-in-Aid system in 
				1974, by the sincere efforts of Late Suranjan Nandi, former 
				Minister, Govt. of Assam. Subsequently the college was included 
				under provincialization Act 2005.
Ramkrishna Nagar College is located at a 
				distance of 55 km, from District Headquarter. It is situated on 
				a 36 Bigha hilly tracks of land, donated by neighbouring Higher 
				Secondary School, Ramkrishna Vidyapith.

Location
Though this place is located in the 
					remotest corner of Assam. It is no more detached from the 
					state capital Guwahati now. It is well connected with the 
					capital by bus service (luxury-coach). Again it is 
					accessible through airway via Silchar. Moreover, it is 
					having fair communication facility to Sribhumi, Hailakandi 
					and Silchar through roadways.

Brief Information of the College
Updates and Information
Our Vision
Our Mission
Your browser does not support inline frames or is currently configured not to display inline frames.
Our vision is to be the preeminent 
					college for research, teaching, and extension of social 
					services, developing leaders to address the global 
					challenges of the 21st century and thereby to bring about 
					the development of the poor underprivileged people of the 
					locality, who have not been able to enjoy even five percent 
					of the fruits of post-independent development. Our vision 
					includes the individual emancipation of a human being from 
					ignorance as well as the collective good of the society at 
					all levels, physical, mental, intellectual and spiritual. 
					And thereby our aim is to make the college a model college 
					and at the same time our vision 2020 is to upgrade the 
					college as a
Rural University
.
Our Commitments
To streamline students' potentiality.
To provide up-dated knowledge and 
					skill.
To provide opportunity for social 
					service through education.
To generate leadership qualities.
To propagate sense of National Unity & 
					Spirit.
Physical fitness through NCC & NSS 
					Wings.
Service to mankind.
Uphold secular views.
Environmental Awareness and 
					Preservation.
To uphold moral values of life.
“WE 
					AT RAMKRISHNA NAGAR COLLEGE ARE COMMITTED TO EXCELLENCE IN 
					EDUCATION, EMPOWERING PERSONALITIES AND DEVELOPING 
					RESPONSIBLE MEMBERS OF SOCIETY”
Our College is a projector to project the overall 
					development of the society in its social, ethical, spiritual 
					and intellectual perspectives.
We cherish the mission of contributing our share in nation 
					building.
To train and instill in the minds of our students the spirit 
					of competitiveness so as to prepare them to meet and accept 
					the incoming challenges of the fiercely competitive world.
In the present era of science technology, it is our mission 
					to equip and acquaint our students with the global 
					perspective of technological world, preparing them, thus to 
					face the world outside.
The institution aims at bringing about a socio-economic 
					development of the society at large, thereby fulfilling the 
					hopes and aspirations of the people.
An institution cannot survive sans a nation and therefore it 
					is our aim to create a bonding amongst different section of 
					people in order to achieve National Integration.
Individuals make the nation ............. To build up the 
					national character, the development of the individual 
					character is a must. It is our motto to help our students to 
					build character by stressing on ethical and moral values, 
					such as HARD WORK, CLEAR VISION, IRON WILL, STRICTEST 
					DISCIPLINE.
